subject: math
name: Mathematics
title: Grade 1 Mathematics: Operations, Place Value & Measurement
overview: Grade 1 mathematics deepens students' conceptual understanding of place value, arithmetic operations, algebraic thinking, measurement, and geometry through rigorous problem-solving routines.
competencies: Demonstrate computational fluency and conceptual flexibility across grade-level operations.
Apply visual models, tape diagrams, and equations to represent and solve multi-step contextual word problems.
Analyze geometric shapes, measurement units, and spatial relationships.
Construct viable mathematical arguments and critique the reasoning of peers.

modules.title: Sums and Differences to 10
modules.description: Developing understanding of addition and subtraction strategies within 10, counting on, and the commutative property.

topics.title: Embedded Numbers and Decompositions
topics.description: Decomposing numbers into number bonds and part-whole pairs within 10.

topics.title: Counting On from Embedded Numbers
topics.description: Using counting on strategies with number paths and ten-frames to solve addition.

topics.title: Subtraction as an Unknown Addend Problem
topics.description: Connecting subtraction to addition using think-addition strategies.

modules.title: Introduction to Place Value Through Addition and Subtraction Within 20
modules.description: Solving word problems within 20, making a ten, and understanding the role of the ten bundle in teen numbers.

topics.title: Counting On and Making Ten Strategies
topics.description: Using 9 + n and 8 + n strategies to decompose addends and make ten.

topics.title: Counting On or Taking from Ten to Subtract
topics.description: Applying take from ten strategies to subtract within 20 efficiently.

modules.title: Ordering and Comparing Length Measurements as Numbers
modules.description: Laying the foundation for length measurement, indirect comparison, and standard ruler measurement.

topics.title: Indirect Comparison in Length
topics.description: Comparing lengths of objects using a third reference object.

topics.title: Standard Length Units and Iteration
topics.description: Laying identical unit cubes end-to-end to measure total length without gaps.

modules.title: Place Value, Comparison, Addition and Subtraction to 40 and 100
modules.description: Understanding tens and ones place value up to 100, comparing two-digit numbers, and adding two-digit numbers.

topics.title: Tens and Ones Place Value
topics.description: Representing numbers with dime/penny models, bundles of straws, and quick tens.

topics.title: Comparing Two-Digit Numbers
topics.description: Using symbols greater than, less than, and equal to compare two-digit values.

topics.title: Addition and Subtraction to 100
topics.description: Adding a two-digit number and a multiple of 10 or a one-digit number.
